name: Gamzee Makara
source:
One of the twelve trolls first seen in Homestuck, Gamzee is befriended in Volume 6 of Pesterquest alongside Vriska.

Despite ranking highly on the hemospectrum, Gamzee is a very relaxed individual who enjoys pies made of sopor slime and talking about miracles.
